divorce_petition.applicable_law: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 / Special Marriage Act, 1954
divorce_petition.court_fees_formula: Court fee of ₹500-1000 depending on grounds
divorce_petition.limitation_calculation: Can be filed anytime during marriage
steps: File divorce petition in family court
divorce_petition.punjab_specific_notes: Family courts established in all districts. Mediation mandatory before trial.

maintenance_petition.applicable_law: Section 125 CrPC / Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act
maintenance_petition.limitation_calculation: Can be claimed anytime during marriage or after divorce
steps: File maintenance petition in magistrate court
maintenance_petition.punjab_specific_notes: Magistrate courts handle up to ₹500/month. Higher amounts go to family court.

custody_petition.applicable_law: Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act / Guardians and Wards Act
steps: File custody petition in family court
Custody awarded based on best interest
custody_petition.punjab_specific_notes: Family courts give paramount consideration to child's welfare and education.

domestic_violence.applicable_law: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
steps: Ex-parte protection order may be granted
domestic_violence.punjab_specific_notes: Magistrate courts handle DV cases. Protection orders effective immediately.

restraining_order.applicable_law: Section 12 Hindu Marriage Act / Domestic Violence Act
restraining_order.limitation_calculation: Filed along with or during divorce proceedings
restraining_order.punjab_specific_notes: Common remedy to prevent alienation of assets or harassment during divorce.
